open Nacl.Public

let encrypt (secret : Secret.t) (public : Public.t) (message : string) : string =
  let nonce = Random.bytes Nacl.Core.nonce_size in
  let ciphertext = Nacl.Secret.box ~nonce ~message ~public ~secret in
  Base64.string_of_bytes ciphertext

let decrypt (secret : Secret.t) (ciphertext : string) : string option =
  let bytes = Base64.bytes_of_string ciphertext in
  match Nacl.Secret.unbox ~nonce:bytes Nacl.Core.nonce_size ~message:bytes ~secret with
  | Ok message -> Some message
  | Error _ -> None

let sign (secret : Secret.t) (message : string) : string =
  let signature = Nacl.Secret.sign ~message ~secret in
  Base64.string_of_bytes signature
